\chapter{List of symbols}
% Use stb-nomenclature + siunitx

\begin{Nomencl}[1cm]
\NomGroup{Constants}%-----------------------------------------------
    \item[$L_0 = $] \qty{300}{mm}

\NomGroup{Variables}%-----------------------------------------------
    \item[$\mathit{Re}_\mathrm{\,D}$]
                       \UnitLine{Reynolds number (diameter)}{~}
    \item[$x$]         \UnitLine{Coordinate                }{m}
    \item[$\ddot{x}$]  \UnitLine{Acceleration              }{m/s^2}\\
    
    \item[$\theta$]    \UnitLine{Rotation angle            }{rad}
    \item[$\tau$]      \UnitLine{Moment                    }{N.m}

\NomGroup{Vectors and Tensors}%-------------------------------------
    \item[$\overrightarrow{\bm{v}}$] Physical vector, see equation ...

\NomGroup{Subscripts}%----------------------------------------------
    \item[$\mathrm{a}$] Adiabatic
    \item[$a$]          Coordinate

\end{Nomencl}

\begin{Nomencl}[1cm]

    \item[CAD] Computer-Aided Design

    \item[DIP] Design Independent Parameter

    \item[EEPROM] Electrically erasable programmable read-only memory
    \item[EMF] Electromotive force
    \item[FBD] Freebody diagram
    \item[FEA] Finite element analysis
    \item[FR] Functional requirement
    \item[GPIO] General pin input/output
    \item[GPS] Global positioning system
    \item[HMI] Human machine interface
    \item[ISR] Interrupt service routine
    \item[MMF] Magnetomotive force
    \item[MOSFET] Metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor
    \item[NSoI] Narrower system of interest
    \item[PCMA] Portable coordinate measuring arm
    \item[PPR] Pulse per revolution
    \item[PSD] Position sensitive detector
    \item[SCADA] Supervisory control and data acquisition
